reason: GET /dnszone and GET /dnszone/{id} return DateCreated, DateModified and NameserversNextCheck without a time zone (for example 2026-11-05T06:28:35), while the spec says date-time (RFC 3339). Creating a zone does return RFC 3339 (2026-11-05T06:27:51.5193271Z). Seen in every API probe run since 2026-11-05 and in the real-API E2E debug logs. The proxy accepts both forms (bunny.BunnyTime); mockbunny copies the behaviour.

match: response header Content-Type has unexpected value: "text/plain"
reason: GET /dnszone/{id}/export returns a BIND zone file as text/plain; the spec documents application/octet-stream. Seen in every API probe run since 2026-11-05 and in the real-API E2E debug logs. mockbunny copies the behaviour.
